name: app_handoff
description: Start an app-managed worker: a Claude subagent that runs as its own session in this bot's folder and reports back to you. Use it wherever you would use the Agent tool (which is off here): give a short name and complete, self-contained instructions; subagent_type picks a .claude/agents definition, model overrides the worker's model (haiku, sonnet, opus). Returns task_id and run at once; the worker's report arrives later as an app message (<app_task_result>). Finish your turn instead of waiting or polling.

name: app_send_message
description: Send words to one of your workers by task_id: joined into its run while it works, or the start of its next run (same session, same task) once it has reported. Its next report comes as an app message.

name: app_cancel_task
description: Stop one of your workers by task_id. Its work so far stays; no report is made.
